description: What does <occupation> pay in <location> — wage percentiles (10th/25th/median/75th/90th, hourly + annual) for a U.S. occupation from the Dept. of Labor CareerOneStop API. Accepts an O*NET/SOC title or code. Example: careeronestop_salary({ occupation: "Registered Nurses", location: "TX", _apiKey: "userId:token" })

location.description: Location: state ("TX"), "City, State" ("Reston, VA"), ZIP ("20191"), or "US" for national data

occupation.description: Occupation keyword, O*NET/SOC title, or code, e.g. "Registered Nurses" or "29-1141.00"

name: careeronestop_salary
title: Careeronestop Salary
